snippet.title: Shopenkraft's Magic Goods Official Trailer
snippet.description:
🎮 Available Now:
Meta Quest Store - https://vr.meta.me/s/2o1Pe0ZwwSyB3sT
PICO XR Store - https://store-global.picoxr.com/global/detail/1/7408925584144957446
👉Join our Discord server: https://discord.gg/nbd3vqZxEx 

In a world brimming with magic where customers demand everything from legendary swords to questionably glowing potions, YOU are the shopkeeper destined to make it all happen. Craft, create, and charm your way through the chaos—or relax with a little cozy shopkeeping magic.

Key Highlights:

🔹 Brew magical potions & experiment with rare ingredients.
🔹 Forge epic weapons for heroes, villains, & picky wizards.
🔹 Tinker with magical trinkets for your strangest clientele.
🔹 Choose your vibe: Challenge Mode, Cozy Mode, Survival Mode, or Zen Mode.
🔹 Unlock upgrades, new recipes, and endless shopkeeping fun!

Your shop, your rules, your legacy. Will you rise to shopkeeping greatness, or get buried under a mountain of potion orders?

Put on your apron, light up the forge, and let the magic begin!
